question: Should OpenClaw permanently adopt this one-way Signal transport migration, including loading only trusted official disabled owners that explicitly opt into invalid-config recovery during doctor/update repair?
rationale: The patch is architecturally aligned with canonical runtime configuration, but it changes a shipped configuration shape and introduces a durable recovery activation rule; source review alone cannot choose the acceptable upgrade and trust boundary.

options.title: Approve the canonical migration boundary
options.body: Accept account-owned transports with doctor-only migration and the explicit trusted-official recovery-owner gate, then require final-head upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow recovery activation further
options.body: Keep the transport migration but require a more restrictive owner-selection policy before allowing disabled plugin recovery during invalid-config maintenance.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Defer the config-shape replacement until maintainers choose a different upgrade or external-plugin recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical migration boundary
recommendation.body: Accept account-owned transports with doctor-only migration and the explicit trusted-official recovery-owner gate, then require final-head upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current member author has carried the full Signal transport, migration, and recovery design through the present branch and can address the resulting maintainer decision.
